issues.summary: Repo has no git history — .git is an empty stub, CI and release workflows have never run
issues.evidence: `.git/` contains only `description` and `info/` (no HEAD, no objects). `git status` → "fatal: not a git repository". `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `release.yml` exist but have never executed; tag v0.2.0 cannot be created.
issues.fix: Initialize the repo, verify `.gitignore` excludes `apps/api/.env`, `*.db`, `.venv-*`, `node_modules`; first commit; push to GitHub remote.
acceptance: `git log` shows an initial commit; `git check-ignore apps/api/.env` returns the path
CI workflow runs green on main (unit + integration + Docker build)
Tag v0.2.0 produces a GitHub Release and a GHCR image

issues.summary: Calendar proposals fail verify when Google is connected live (loop stuck in `executing`)
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/services/osClose.ts:450` sets `created: gmail?.mode !== "oauth"`. With live OAuth `created` is false, so `verifyProposal` throws 409 "Nothing to verify" and the loop stays `executing`. No Calendar API call is made at all.
issues.fix: On approve of an `event` proposal with OAuth, call Google Calendar `events.insert`, store `eventId` in resultJson; keep demo path simulated.
acceptance: Live OAuth: approve → event created in Google Calendar → loop `done`
Demo mode unchanged
Harness test covers event approve-send in demo and with stubbed Calendar fetch

issues.summary: OsSensors runs in every window — one ⌘⇧L creates duplicate clip loops and ambient posts double
issues.evidence: `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx` mounts `<OsSensors />` for every route. In the macOS shell both the Desktop and quick sheet WebViews receive `juv-os-clip-hotkey` and each POSTs `/os/loops/clip`; ambient is sampled twice per minute. John's 2026-11-08 screenshot shows two identical "Clipped while in Cursor" loops.
issues.fix: Run sensors in exactly one owner (quick sheet / agent route, or native side) — not per WebView.
acceptance: One ⌘⇧L press = exactly one `/os/loops/clip` request (verified via audit log)
Ambient posts once per interval with Desktop and sheet both open

issues.summary: Legacy stub clip loops ("Clipped while in …") still sit in band HIGH and outrank mail
issues.evidence: dev.db query: `select band,count(*) from Loop where source='clip' and status in ('open','proposed')` → `high|5`, all titled `Clipped while in …`. Current `createClipLoop` (osLoops.ts) caps clips at `normal` and refuses stub clips, but old rows predate that rule.
issues.fix: One-time migration: dismiss open stub clip loops with audit reason `legacy_weak_clip`; demote any other open clip loop above `normal`.
acceptance: Same query returns 0 HIGH clip loops
Audit events recorded per dismissed loop
Migration is idempotent (second run changes nothing)

issues.summary: LLM polish rewrites every draft as an email reply — todo/checklist/event drafts get turned into emails
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/services/osClose.ts:158` prompt is fixed: "You draft a short professional email reply…". `maybeLlmPolish` runs for todo, clip, voice-checklist and event proposals whenever `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set.
issues.fix: Prompt per proposal kind (reply / event / todo / voice-email); todo stays a checklist.
acceptance: Unit test with mocked Anthropic client asserts kind-specific prompt
Voice todo draft remains a numbered checklist after polish

issues.summary: Quick sheet "Open Desktop" drops the focused loop id in the macOS bridge
issues.evidence: `apps/desktop/src/windows/QuickSheet.tsx` calls `openDesktop(top?.id)`, but `OsWebBridge.swift:97` defines `openDesktop: function () { return call("openDesktop"); }` — argument discarded; Desktop opens on its default view.
issues.fix: Pass `loopId` through the bridge → `ShellController.openDesktop(loopId:)` → Desktop URL param → Desktop focuses that loop.
acceptance: Open Desktop from sheet lands on the same loop with its draft open

issues.summary: Voice email drafts can't send: add new-message Gmail send + recipient resolution
issues.evidence: Hold-fn voice (2026-11-08) creates `objectType: voice`, proposal kind `todo` (`apps/api/src/services/osVoice.ts`). "Draft an email to my investors" closes locally only — no new-message compose exists (only `sendGmailReply` to a thread) and "investors" is not resolved to addresses.
issues.fix: Resolve recipients from Gmail sent history/contacts; ambiguous → user picks in ModalityHost; send new message via Gmail behind the same approve + SENI grant.
acceptance: Voice "email Sarah about X" → draft with resolved To: → Approve & send → message in Gmail Sent
Unresolved recipient blocks send with a picker, never guesses
Harness test with stubbed Gmail fetch

issues.summary: Session JWT stored in plaintext UserDefaults (macOS) and localStorage (web)
issues.evidence: `apps/macos/JuvantageOSMac/Services/TokenStore.swift` reads/writes the JWT via `UserDefaults.standard` (plaintext plist in ~/Library/Preferences). `apps/desktop/src/lib/api.ts:24-29` uses `localStorage`; `QuickSheetWebView.swift` injects the token into WebKit localStorage.
issues.fix: macOS: Keychain (kSecClassGenericPassword); WebViews obtain the token via the bridge, not localStorage.
acceptance: `defaults read com.juvantage.os.mac` shows no token
Token present in Keychain; logout removes it
Mac WebViews work with localStorage token absent

issues.summary: API boots with default JWT secret and reuses it as the OAuth token encryption key
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/lib/env.ts:11` falls back to `"dev-secret-change-me"`; `env.ts:27-28` `tokenEncryptionKey` falls back to `JWT_SECRET` then `"dev-token-key"`. No startup check — a misconfigured deploy runs with forgeable tokens and encrypts Google refresh tokens with a known key.
issues.fix: Fail fast when `NODE_ENV=production` (or `DEMO_MODE=false`) and either secret is missing/default; require distinct keys.
acceptance: Prod boot without JWT_SECRET exits non-zero with a clear error
Prod boot with TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY == JWT_SECRET exits non-zero
Unit test for the guard

issues.summary: Dev API listens on all interfaces with seeded demo login and CORS "*"
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/index.ts` calls `serve({ fetch, port })` with no hostname (Node binds all interfaces). `env.ts:14` CORS defaults to `*`. `prisma/seed.ts:26` seeds `john@juvantage.com / demo1234`. Anyone on the same Wi-Fi can log in to the dev API, which holds live Gmail-derived loops after OAuth.
issues.fix: Default bind `127.0.0.1` (override via `HOST` for Docker); CORS default to the Vite origin; refuse seeded demo password when a live OAuth connector exists.
acceptance: `lsof -iTCP:3001 -sTCP:LISTEN` shows 127.0.0.1 only in dev
docker-compose still reachable (HOST=0.0.0.0 inside container)
Preflight from a non-allowed origin rejected

issues.summary: ESLint is non-functional — no flat config, no lint step in CI
issues.evidence: `npx eslint apps/desktop/src/windows/QuickSheet.tsx` (2026-11-08) prints the ESLint 9 flat-config migration error; no `eslint.config.*` exists in the repo; root package.json has no `lint` script.
issues.fix: Add `eslint.config.js` (TS + React hooks rules), `npm run lint`, CI step.
acceptance: `npm run lint` passes on main
CI fails on a lint error

issues.summary: Closable object types defined twice (API + shared) — drifts on every new object type
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/services/osModality.ts:60` hard-codes the list; `packages/shared/src/os.ts` has `CLOSABLE_OBJECT_TYPES`. Adding `voice` on 2026-11-08 required editing both.
acceptance: Single source of truth; contract test asserts API and shared agree

issues.summary: No automated tests for the macOS shell (no XCTest target; fn push-to-talk state machine untested)
issues.evidence: `apps/macos/project.yml` defines only the app target. `VoiceController.handle(type:flags:)` (hold threshold, fn+key cancel, release-to-send) has zero tests; CI does not build the Mac app.
issues.fix: Extract fn state machine into a pure type; add XCTest target; CI macOS job runs `xcodebuild test`.
acceptance: Tests: tap < 220ms ignored; hold starts; fn+key cancels; release delivers
CI macOS job green

issues.summary: HTTP harness never exercises the live Gmail execute branch (P0.1 path untested in CI)
issues.evidence: `apps/api/src/integration/closeDemo.harness.test.ts` covers demo mail + voice only. The OAuth branch in `osClose.ts:340-425` (send-scope check, threadId, `sendGmailReply`, 401 handling) has no automated coverage — the `accessToken is not defined` bug reached John manually.
issues.fix: Harness case with an oauth connector row and stubbed `fetch` for Gmail send.
acceptance: Asserts MIME To/Subject/threadId sent to Gmail
Asserts 401 → "Gmail session expired" error
Runs in CI without network

issues.summary: First-run permission check for Microphone, Speech and Accessibility + fn-key conflict guidance
issues.evidence: `VoiceController.beginListening` only shows an error pill when Mic/Speech are denied; global fn/⌘⇧L monitors silently don't fire without Accessibility (no `AXIsProcessTrusted` check). macOS "Press 🌐 key to" emoji/dictation can fire on fn release.
issues.fix: Native first-run checklist panel: status per permission, deep links to System Settings, fn-key setting hint.
acceptance: Fresh install shows checklist; each item turns green when granted
Accessibility missing is detected and explained

issues.summary: Hold-fn voice has only been compiled, never verified on hardware
issues.evidence: 2026-11-08: `xcodebuild` BUILD SUCCEEDED and API harness passes for `/os/loops/voice`, but no human has run the native path (fn monitor, mic, SFSpeech, pill, sheet handoff).
issues.fix: Device QA run with recorded results.
acceptance: Pass: hold fn → pill + live transcript
Pass: release → sheet focuses new draft, pill reports result
Pass: fn tap and fn+arrow do not trigger
Pass: denied mic shows guidance
Pass: API down → pill shows "Quick sheet didn't answer" within 10s

issues.evidence: `infrastructure/services/os_brain/main.tf` exists; `infrastructure/envs/dev/` contains only README.md — no backend config, no tfvars, no state. Blocked on AWS account/credentials from John.

Secrets via AWS Secrets Manager module, none in tfvars

issues.summary: Dogfood journal Days 2–14 unfilled — Day 14 gate decision has no data
issues.evidence: `docs/DOGFOOD_JOURNAL.md` has Day 1 filled (2026-11-08); Day 2–14 sections are empty templates. `/os/metrics` (clear/accept/edit rates) is the data source.
issues.fix: Daily entry from `/os/metrics` + 2-line human note; consider auto-filling metrics.
acceptance: 14 entries with metrics; Day 14 go/no-go recorded

issues.summary: AI Engineering Operations — architecture proposal before build (Jira + GitHub, human-supervised)
issues.evidence: Agreed 2026-11-08: Juvantage OS should create/maintain Jira work for our own org so new hires land in organized work. Spec requires an architecture proposal, roadmap, dependencies and acceptance criteria before large implementation; must reuse ModalityHost + approve/SENI grants and not break Gmail P0.1.
issues.fix: Architecture doc: Jira connector (OAuth 3LO), ticket proposals as Loop/Proposal objects, duplicate detection via JQL label, approval tiers, audit trail, GitHub PR/CI linkage.
acceptance: Proposal reviewed by CTO gate and John
Ticket creation flows through the existing approve gate (no autonomous high-impact actions)
